name: '🚀 Feature Request'
about: Suggest an idea or a new capability for tsc-alias
title: '[FR] Short description of your feature idea'
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## 💡 Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.

A clear and concise description of what the problem or limitation is.
_(e.g., "I'm frustrated because tsc-alias doesn't support the new `.mts` extensions when rewriting paths...")_

## 🌟 Describe the solution you'd like

Describe the ideal behavior or feature you want to be added to `tsc-alias`. Explain how it should work or what new command-line option you want to introduce.

## 💻 Example Usage / Proposed Syntax

If applicable, show how this feature would be used in the CLI or configuration.

```bash
# Example CLI command
tsc-alias --my-new-option
```

```json
// Example in tsconfig.json or custom config if relevant
"tsc-alias": {
  "someSetting": true
}
```

## 🎯 Use Case & Benefits

Why should this feature be added to `tsc-alias`? Who will benefit from it? How does it improve the TypeScript build ecosystem?

## 🔄 Alternatives you've considered

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or workarounds you've tried or considered (e.g., using custom replacers).

## 📝 Additional Context

Add any other context, screenshots, or code examples about the feature request here.

### 🎯 Project Sustainability Notice

This project is open-source and maintained entirely on personal time.

- **Community Roadmap:** New ideas and feature requests are welcome and will be reviewed as time allows.
- **Priority Development:** If your organization needs this feature built urgently or requires custom integration for a production environment, you can fund its development via our **Bug Bounty / Issue Prioritization Tier** on GitHub Sponsors. Funded issues are picked up immediately.
